lines.x: The benchmark KSE-100 index shed 913.14 points, or 0.51%, to 176,604.59 in early trade, driven down by widespread selling in banking, cement, and energy exploration shares.
Gold prices in Pakistan fell by Rs3,500 per tola to Rs376,336 following a decline in international bullion markets.
Buying returned to the Pakistan Stock Exchange as the KSE-100 Index surged 1,191.19 points, or 0.68%, to reach 177,485.52.
Standard Chartered projects the State Bank of Pakistan could raise its key policy rate to 13% by June 2027.
